messages.subject: Heads of terms — Caspian Atlas
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Following our pricing call, here's where I think we've landed on the commercial shape: Enterprise tier at £285k for year one with a 4% annual uplift, £95k data licence, £60k onboarding, 150 named users included. Whitfield Carter will write this up as heads of terms. Open items are payment terms, the SLA uptime number and the liability cap.

Daniel
